newsitem.title: USA: Aon Corp unit to redeem preferred shares.
newsitem.headline: Aon Corp unit to redeem preferred shares.

text.p: Alexander & Alexander Services Inc, a unit of Aon Corp, said Monday it will exercise its right to redeem all of its Series A preferred stock on March 22.
Preferred shareholders will have until the close of business March 17 to convert any or all of their shares into $52.84 in cash for each share, Alexander & Alexander said.
The company said after that date, holders will receive $52.18 in cash for each share redeemed, plus the amount equal to the accrued and unpaid dividends, for a total price of $52.25 a share.
Aon is an insurance services holding company.
Its shares closed unchanged Monday at 63-3/8.
